jobs.description: Serco is an international provider of services to governments and public organisations, operating across sectors where delivery, public confidence and reputation matter. In Europe, Serco works through both established Serco operations and specialist local businesses, combining international capability with a strong understanding of national requirements and operating environments.European Homecare (EHC) in Germany and ORS in Switzerland are part of Serco and provide immigration and social care services in their respective markets. Each business has its own history, identity, workforce and stakeholder environment. Communications must therefore be locally relevant and sensitive to the nature of the services delivered, while supporting closer alignment with Serco’s standards, values, channels and wider European direction.The European Communications team supports operations across 10 countries, four sectors and five languages. It provides strategic advice, shared standards and specialist support across internal communications, media relations, issues and crisis communications, digital content and reputation. This role is the senior local communications lead for EHC in Germany and leads internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, while working as an integral member of the European Communications team.The postholder will have the autonomy to shape and deliver communications locally, working closely with local leaders and drawing on the expertise and support of the European Communications team. The role calls for sound judgement, curiosity and a practical approach to strengthening employee understanding, engagement and reputation as EHC and ORS continue their journey within Serco.Key purpose  - Lead communications for EHC in Germany across internal and external channels, ensuring communications are accurate, relevant and appropriate for a sensitive public-service environment.- Own internal communications for ORS in Switzerland, helping leaders keep employees informed, engaged and connected to local priorities and Serco’s wider direction.- Act as a trusted communications adviser to the EHC and ORS leadership teams, providing clear, practical and well-judged counsel, including in complex, sensitive or fast-moving situations.- Build strong networks across the local businesses and Serco Europe, connecting people, expertise and information so communications are coordinated and effective.- Support the continued integration of EHC and ORS within Serco, respecting their local identities while embedding Serco’s communications standards, governance, channels and values.Structure and reporting relationship The role reports to the Customer Relations (CR) & Operations Director Switzerland. The postholder is also a core member of the European Communications team and works closely with the Director of Communications, Marketing and Public Affairs Europe and European Communications colleagues on priorities, standards, governance and delivery. The role operates with a high degree of independence and works closely with EHC leadership in Germany and ORS leadership in Switzerland.  Internal Communications- Own and deliver the internal communications plans for EHC in Germany and ORS in Switzerland, including print and digital newsletters, leadership updates, employee announcements, change communications and internal campaigns, working closely with local leaders and the European Communications team.- Draft and distribute newsletters; act as an internal correspondent to identify and write impactful stories.- Lead employee engagement initiatives aligned with Serco’s values and business priorities.- Develop and maintain content for internal platforms.  External Communications- Lead day-to-day media relations in Germany and preferably Switzerland, including media monitoring, handling enquiries, preparing spokespeople and coordinating responses with European Communications colleagues when required.- Lead local issues management and crisis communications preparedness, providing calm, practical and well-judged advice to leaders in sensitive or difficult situations.- Produce clear written and visual content for external channels, including social media, in line with European Communications standards and priorities.- Manage the German-speaking  website of Immigration Europe and related external digital content for Germany and Switzerland, in line with European Communications standards and approvals.Integration Communications- Contribute to integration plans following recent acquisitions, ensuring employees and stakeholders are informed and engaged.- Apply strong change communications judgement, identifying how different audiences may respond to change and adapting messages, channels and engagement approaches to their needs and sensitivities.Social Media & Content Creation- Collaborate with the European communications team to source, create, and promote content that showcases services, people, and impact.Stakeholder Engagement- Build and sustain trusted relationships across operations, HR, corporate functions and leadership teams, creating effective networks within EHC in Germany, ORS in Switzerland and the wider European business.- Represent the European Communications function locally. Act as a trusted communications adviser to EHC leaders in Germany across the full communications remit and to ORS leaders in Switzerland on internal communications, constructively challenging proposed approaches where reputational, employee or stakeholder considerations require it.- For German-speaking market, develop and maintain strong working relationships with relevant media, partners, public authorities and other external stakeholders, supported by accurate and well-maintained contact information and external specialist partners.Essential technical and professional skills, knowledge, and qualifications - Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Public Relations or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.- At least seven years’ relevant communications experience, including substantial responsibility for advising senior leaders, managing communications independently and delivering through influence in a complex, matrixed organisation.- Proven experience across internal communications, external communications, media relations, change communications and employee engagement.- Strong change management and change communications acumen, with the ability to understand audience sensitivities, anticipate resistance and translate complex change into clear, relevant communications.- Excellent planning and organisational skills, with the ability to prioritise competing demands across two businesses and maintain consistent delivery.- Demonstrable experience of working with journalists, handling media enquiries and advising spokespeople, with the judgement to manage sensitive or high-pressure situations.- Strong digital communications capability, including confident use of Microsoft 365, SharePoint and content management tools.- Ability to brief and manage specialist creative support when needed, ensuring outputs meet communications objectives and brand standards.- Able to navigate a large, matrixed company while remaining pragmatic, visible and hands-on within smaller subsidiaries. Comfortable balancing accountability to a local operational leader with active membership of a European functional team, adapting style without compromising communications standards.- Sound understanding of, or experience in, public services, immigration, social care, government or another sensitive, regulated operating environment.Additional / special features of the role - Highly self-sufficient and dependable, with the judgement to set priorities, make sound decisions, escalate appropriately and maintain delivery without close supervision.- Credible, politically aware and collaborative, with the interpersonal confidence to build networks, sustain trusted relationships and influence colleagues from operational teams to senior leadership.- Inclusive and audience-focused, prepared to reach beyond familiar channels and proactively engage employees and stakeholders with different roles, backgrounds, levels of access and communications needs.- Calm and resilient in demanding or ambiguous environments, able to handle sensitive issues, challenge constructively, protect confidentiality and maintain effective relationships during difficult situations.- Tech-savvy and adaptable to new digital tools and platforms.- Interested in the evolution of the immigration market in Europe, incl. the politicial impact on the business of the Sector Immigration EuropeDesirable- Must: German native or fully proficient- Must: English level B2- Desirable: French- Experience in regulated environments or public sector communications.Homeoffice:Umfang: Nach Vereinbarung

Studios that own their work, share the upside and back each other.rcp has a strong reputation and a weak brand. For you, that’s room: you get to put your own stamp on it.How we work• Roles, not positions. Inspired by holacracy. One person often holds several roles, and roles change as the work changes• Strikeforces. A direct line to the CEO.Why this role exists Our CEO built rcp’s top relationships over 20 years. You don’t manage a team. You play games• Business-fluent English. jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description: A Snapshot of Your Day As Strategic Project & Escalation Manager (f/m/d), you play a pivotal role in ensuring the successful execution of Siemens Energy's most critical GIS (gas insulated switchgear) and AIS (air insulated switchgear) customer projects across Europe. You act as the connecting link between project execution, business leadership, and operational functions, ensuring that risks, priorities, and escalations are addressed proactively and transparently.You work closely with Project Managers, Regional Leaders, Business Management, Engineering, Manufacturing, Procurement, Logistics, Customer Centers, and Order Management teams to resolve complex challenges and enable informed decision-making. Your work directly contributes to delivery performance, customer satisfaction, and the sustainable growth of our Grid Technologies business.No two days are alike. Depending on the situation, you may lead strategic initiatives, manage high-impact escalations, assess contractual implications, prepare executive decision papers, facilitate cross-functional workshops, or support leadership teams in defining priorities across a dynamic project portfolio.How You’ll Make an Impact * Lead strategic cross-functional projects and support business transformation initiatives across Order Management Switchgears Europe* Coordinate the resolution of critical project escalations and drive actions to mitigate schedule, delivery, and execution risks* Establish transparency regarding project risks, opportunities, constraints, and priorities to support effective decision-making and with that, contribute to a proactive escalation culture focused on transparency, accountability, and customer success* Collaborate with Project Managers, Regional Leaders, and Senior Management to align project priorities, resource allocation, and business decisions* Analyze customer contracts and commercial commitments, and prepare decision materials, business cases, status reports, and management presentations* Facilitate alignment and solution development across Order Management, AIS, GIS, Logistics, Procurement, Planning, Manufacturing, and Customer Center organizationsWhat You Bring* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a comparable discipline* Many years of experience in complex project management, program management, order execution, or a related business environment, including cross-functional initiatives and escalation management involving multiple stakeholders and organizational interfaces* Strong understanding of customer projects within an industrial, infrastructure, energy, manufacturing, or engineering environment* Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills and the ability to navigate technical, commercial, contractual, and operational topics while balancing strategic decisions with hands-on problem solving* Experience in project governance, stakeholder management, executive communications, and managing competing priorities in a fast-paced environment* Outstanding communication, presentation, negotiation, and collaboration skills, and you are fluent in German and English, both written and spokenAbout the TeamOur Grid Technology division enables a reliable, sustainable, and digital grid. The power grid is the backbone of the energy transition. Siemens Energy offers a leading portfolio and solutions in HVDC transmission, grid stabilization and storage, high voltage switchgears and transformers, and digital grid technology.  Who is Siemens Energy? At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With ~100.000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.      Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideoOur Commitment to Diversity Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences. Rewards/Benefits * In addition to an attractive remuneration package in line with the market, you can expect an attractive employer-financed company pension scheme* We also offer the opportunity to become a Siemens Energy shareholder* We offer our employees the opportunity to work flexibly and remotely, and our inspiring offices provide space for collaboration and creativity* The professional and personal development of our employees is very important to us. We provide them with the opportunities to learn and develop in a self-determined way, various attractive programmes and learning materials are available for this purpose* In relation to the "compatibility of family and work", we have a wide range of offers, e.g. flexible working time models, childcare places at many locations, the possibility of trial part-time work or even a sabbatical  We value equal opportunities and welcome applications from people with disabilities.https://jobs.siemens-energy.com/jobs #RPO
